concerns.text: The plan states that a logistic regression model will be fitted and then a binary‑search will be performed on the hold‑out validation set to find the *feature vector* where the predicted probability equals 0.5, calling this the “complexity threshold”. However, the procedure for locating a unique feature vector is under‑specified: many different combinations of the three predictors can yield a 0.5 probability, and a binary search over a multivariate space is not well defined. The plan should clarify which feature(s) are being varied (e.g., fixing two predictors at their mean and varying the third) or adopt a univariate analysis (e.g., marginal effect) to define a reproducible threshold.
